package.author: Ramiro Norman Arnold
package.description: A Windows desktop app for discovering, organizing, inspecting, and launching local Git repositories.
package.installationNotes: Git must be available on PATH for repository discovery and Git features. RepoManager is currently unsigned, so Windows may display an unknown-publisher or reputation warning when the application is first launched.

en-US.author: Ramiro Norman Arnold
en-US.description: A Windows desktop app for discovering, organizing, inspecting, and launching local Git repositories.
en-US.installationNotes: Git must be available on PATH for repository discovery and Git features. RepoManager is currently unsigned, so Windows may display an unknown-publisher or reputation warning when the application is first launched.
en-US.longDescription: RepoManager is a Windows desktop application for discovering, organizing, inspecting, and launching local Git repositories. It provides a single view of repository status, branches, working trees, health findings, notes, pinning, and supported development tools while keeping repository changes deliberate and user-controlled.
en-US.name: RepoManager
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed
Changes/diff previews now work when Git would emit an LF/CRLF warning after an external edit. This also covers repositories without a remote. Refresh, staged/unstaged previews and repository switching have regression coverage.
The warning is suppressed only for read-only inspection. Line-ending conversion and Stage/Commit safeguards are unchanged. Automatic Git inspection still cannot launch helper processes; helper-dependent operations remain unavailable instead of being reported as clean.

Download
Use RepoManager-0.1.4-windows-x64.zip. Extract the full folder and run RepoManager/RepoManager.exe.
Windows 10 22H2 / Windows 11 x64. Git must be on PATH. The executable is unsigned; SmartScreen may warn. Windows Terminal is required only for the Terminal action, and PowerShell 7 is not required. No automatic updater.
